text: NGK spark plugs are made by Niterra Co., Ltd. (English name of NGK SPARK PLUG CO., LTD. changed to Niterra Co., Ltd. in 2023), listed on both the Tokyo and Nagoya stock exchanges.
short: NGK is Niterra Co., Ltd., listed in Tokyo and Nagoya.
